entries.as: 晶澳太阳能与金石能源联合开发出一款转换效率高达28.2%的混合背接触（HBC）太阳能电池。该效率结果已获得德国TÜV Rheinland的认证。据两家公司表示，这一成果刷新了单结硅太阳能电池和背接触（BC）太阳能电池的效率世界纪录。

entries.b:
JA Solar, Gold Stone Energy claim world’s highest efficiency for silicon solar cells with 28.2%-efficient back contact device
The result was certified by TÜV Rheinland and represents the highest efficiency ever recorded for a single-junction silicon solar cells.
May 25, 2026
Vincent Shaw
Modules & Upstream Manufacturing
Technology and R&D
China
A production line of Golden Stone Energy
Image: Golden Stone Energy
Share
Chinese PV manufacturer JA Solar and China-based PV equipment supplier Gold Stone Energy have reported a 28.2% conversion efficiency for a hybrid back-contact (HBC) solar cell developed under their HBC industrialization project.
The result was certified by Germany’s TÜV Rheinland and, according to the companies, sets a new world record for back-contact (BC) solar cell efficiency. The previous record for the BC architecture was held by Longi, which reported
28.13% efficiency for its hybrid interdigitated back-contact (HIBC) cell
.
HBC technology combines a back-contact electrode structure with passivation technologies used in mainstream high-efficiency crystalline silicon cell architectures. The cell front side has no metal gridlines, reducing optical shading losses, while the rear-contact design improves current collection. The technology is also intended to provide an upgrade path for existing TOPCon manufacturing assets.
Gold Stone Energy and JA Solar were previously linked through a 4 GW HBC upgrade and retrofit project. In a Hong Kong Stock Exchange filing, Golden Solar said its subsidiary Golden Solar New Energy Technology would license HBC patent technology to a joint venture established by JA Solar's unit Yiwu JA Solar and Gold Stone Energy. The project aims to produce HBC cells by retrofitting existing production capacity.
The announcement follows several recent back-contact efficiency gains by Chinese PV manufacturers. In late April, Trina Solar said its TOPCon-compatible hybrid back-contact (THBC) cell achieved
28.0% efficiency
, certified by Germany’s Institute for Solar Energy Research Hamelin (ISFH). The company said the result was achieved using a large-area 210R cell and added that it is accelerating THBC module industrialization.
The series of announcements highlights growing competition around back-contact architectures, as leading Chinese manufacturers pursue higher conversion efficiencies and improved module power density following the rapid commercialization of TOPCon technology.

SAIC Motor
This electric SUV with a semi-solid-state EV battery costs less than $15,000 in China
Peter Johnson
| May 27 2026 - 7:45 am PT
11 Comments
SAIC launched its first electric SUV powered by a
semi-solid-state EV battery
in China, starting at under $15,000.
The MG 4X is an EV SUV with semi-solid-state batteries
After launching
the new MG 4
last year, or the “world’s first mass-produced semi-solid-state EV,” as the Chinese automaker calls it, SAIC is following it up with its first electric SUV under the new series.
SAIC officially launched the MG 4X in China on Wednesday, starting at just 99,800 yuan ($14,700), matching the price of
blind preorders
that opened earlier this month. For a limited time, the MG 4X can be bought for as low as 92,800 yuan ($13,700) with incentives.
The electric SUV is available with two battery pack options from “top-tier” battery suppliers, including a 53.9 kWh semi-solid-state battery from SAIC Qingtao and a 64.2 kWh LFP (lithium iron phosphate ) CATL battery.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
The semi-solid-state (53.9 kWh) battery offers a CLTC range of up to 510 km (317 miles), while the larger (64.2 kWh) CATL LFP battery delivers up to 610 km (379 miles).
SAIC MG 4 and MG 4X, both equipped with a semi-solid-state EV battery (Source: SAIC MG)
While the base model is equipped with a 125 kW (167 hp) rear-mounted electric motor, higher-priced versions gain a more powerful 150 kW (201 hp) motor.
The MG 4X measures 4,500 mm in length, 1,849 mm in width, and 1,621 mm in height, with a wheelbase of 2,735 mm, or about the size of the BYD Yuan Plus (sold as the Atto 3 overseas).
Like the new MG 4, the electric SUV features SAIC’s new intelligent cockpit design with a large 15.6″ floating central infotainment screen and a smaller 10.25″ driver display. The setup includes Horizon L2 intelligent assisted driving, offering ADAS features including high-speed NOA and all-scenario remote parking.
SAIC teamed up with smartphone maker Oppo to offer full in-car connectivity, providing access to CarPlay, HiCar, and more directly from the driver’s smartphone.
The new MG 4X is offered in Free and Smart Editions, offering various safety and convenience features. The entry-level Free models are equipped with 5 cameras and 8 ultrasonic radars, while the Smart Edition models feature a more advanced setup with 21 smart sensors in total.
SAIC claimed that reducing the liquid electrolyte content to just 5% significantly reduces the risk of combustion and improves the cycle life in the semi-solid-state EV battery.

The battery underwent two needle penetration tests, producing no smoke, fires, or explosions after two hours, which SAIC MG said was an industry first and exceeded industry standards by 20%.
While SAIC’s electric SUV is now on sale in China, the company is bringing its semi-solid-state EV batteries,
MG SolidCore Battery
, to Europe in 2026.
The new MG4 EV Urban will go on sale in Europe with the same battery, but under WLTP conditions, the driving range will likely fall to around 400 km (248 miles).
The new battery tech unlocks longer driver ranges, faster charging speeds, enhanced safety, and improved performance in cold weather. According to SAIC, the semi-solid-state batteries have been “refined to accommodate regional road conditions, climate variations, and regulatory requirements.”

entries.t: DAS Solar 与新南威尔士大学打造效率 27%、银含量更低的隧道背接触太阳能电池
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能源测/发电技术/光伏
entries.as: 新南威尔士大学（UNSW）与DAS Solar合作，为隧穿氧化物钝化背接触（TBC）硅太阳能电池开发了一种无主栅金属栅线优化技术。该技术能更高效地在背面收集电流，同时将银耗量降低了3至4毫克/瓦。首批采用该技术量产的TBC电池转换效率已超过27%。
kp: 转换效率[隧道氧化物钝化背接触(TBC)硅太阳能电池量产]: >27%
银消耗量[零母线金属网格优化方法]: 降低3-4 mg/W
entries.b:
DAS Solar, UNSW build tunnel back-contact solar cell with 27% efficiency, lower silver content
Researchers from UNSW and DAS Solar developed a zero-busbar metal grid optimization approach for tunnel oxide passivated back-contact (TBC) silicon solar cells, enabling more efficient current collection at the rear surface while reducing silver consumption by 3–4 mg/W. The first TBC cells produced in mass manufacturing using this technique have demonstrated efficiencies exceeding 27%.
May 25, 2026
Emiliano Bellini
Modules & Upstream Manufacturing
Technology and R&D
Australia
China
The TBC cell
Image: DAS Solar
Share
A research team comprising scientists from the
University of New South Wales
(UNSW) in Australia and Chinese PV manufacturer
DAS Solar
have developed a new technique for the optimization of metal grid design of silicon back contact (BC) solar cells applying tunnel oxide passivated contact (TBC) at the rear surface.
The cell is based on a zero-busbar (ZBB) design, which the scientists said required significantly lower silver (Ag) content for metallization.
“Compared with the multi-busbar (MBB) schemes, the ZBB design cuts silver paste consumption by around 3-4 mg/W,” the research's lead author, Dengyuan Song, told
pv magazine
. “The specific value varies slightly according to different metallization pattern designs of solar cells. Such a reduction in silver consumption is highly significant and practically remarkable. In particular, under the current frequent fluctuations in silver prices, lowering silver consumption plays a vital role in stabilizing production costs, and supporting the large-scale industrialization of TBC solar cells.”
“Supported by advanced solar cell simulation technology from UNSW, DAS Solar began mass production of ZBB TBC cell technology in early to the second half of 2025. The series welding equipment, soldering processes, and silver pastes have been fully optimized and are ready for industrial-scale manufacturing,” Song went on to say. “
At present, DAS Solar has realized large-scale production of TBC cells with silver consumption of approximately 6 mg/W. The peak conversion efficiency of premium batches in mass production exceeds 27%, which further proves that ZBB technology possesses excellent cost performance.”
The 160-μm-thick ZBB TBC cell has dimensions of 182 mm × 105 mm. The front surface is textured with random upright pyramids at a 53° base angle and passivated using an aluminum oxide (Al₂O₃)/silicon nitride (SiNₓ)/silicon dioxide (SiO₂) stack. The inclusion of a low-refractive-index SiO₂ layer further reduces front-surface reflectance.
The experimental setting
Image: DAS Solar
At the rear side, the device relies on p-type polycrystalline silicon, n-type polycrystalline silicon, and an undoped gap region. The p-poly and n-poly regions are planar to enhance surface passivation quality.
Using SunSolve for optical modelling and Quokka3 for electrical modelling, the academics measured the performance of the ZBB TBC cell and compared it to that of a reference device built with typical electrical contact pads used as current collection and interconnection points.
Optical results indicate that current generation is largely insensitive to finger width, but decreases slightly as finger pitch increases due to reduced light trapping. For pad-based designs, performance was primarily found to be limited by busbar-related losses, making wider and more numerous busbars and pads beneficial for efficiency. In contrast, zero-busbar (ZBB) designs shift current collection to fingers, where losses scale more strongly with finger geometry, favoring larger busbar segmentation and efficient current routing.
Across both architectures, reducing finger width via improved screen-printing technology offers clear efficiency gains. Pad-based cells were found to require at least 11 mg/W of Ag paste, while ZBB cells maintain similar efficiency at 7 mg/W.
“The absolute efficiency gain of ZBB over pad-based TBC is at least 0.1%, which would significantly increase if Ag paste consumption were below 10 mg/W. From the reduction of Ag paste consumption point of view, ZBB configuration is definitely advantageous, although the increased challenge of interconnection and module reliability requires careful examination,” the academics concluded.
The new methodology was described in “
Grid Optimization of Tunnel Oxide Passivated Back Contact Silicon Solar Cells
,” published in
Progress in Photovoltaics
.
In
another recent study conducted with UNSW
, DAS Solar unveiled a new circuit-model–based method to accurately detect hot-spot risks in TOPCon back-contact modules, overcoming limitations of the IEC 61215 approach caused by low shunt resistance.

entries.t: 30%+效率！曜能科技全球首片G12H p-HJT钙钛矿叠层电池喜获认证，正式探索太空光伏领域
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能源测/发电技术/光伏
entries.as: 曜能科技自主研发的G12H钙钛矿/p-HJT叠层电池通过中国计量科学研究院认证，全尺寸光电转换效率达30.53%。该电池利用两端叠层结构实现全光谱高效分段利用，效率对标航天级三结砷化镓。通过减薄工艺，电池具备可弯折和高比功率特性，满足航天器轻质柔性需求。该产品兼容现有系统设计，兼具高性能与低量产成本，正式迈出探索太空光伏领域第一步。
kp: 光电转化效率[G12H p-HJT钙钛矿叠层电池]: 30.53%
[尺寸规格[G12H p-HJT钙钛矿叠层电池]: 210mm*105mm
[叠层结构[p-HJT叠层电池]: 两端(2-Terminal)叠层结构
[核心优势[p-HJT电池]: 具备较高辐射耐受性和极低成本，适配现有perc及下一代系统设计
[物理特性[p-HJT叠层电池]: 通过减薄工艺具备可弯折特性及高比功率
entries.b:
近日，曜能科技（Auner）自主研发的 G12H (210mm*105mm) 钙钛矿/p型异质结（p-HJT）叠层电池正式通过中国计量科学研究院（NIM）认证，全尺寸光电转化效率达到30.53%。该成果是曜能科技在n型叠层电池核心工艺路线上的持续进化，也是向太空光伏方向布局的第一步。依托于自建产线上底电池及叠层顶电池的全流程开发能力，曜能科技率先完成了全球第一个p-HJT叠层电池的标准量产尺寸产品认证。
在商业航天太空探索的时代背景下，太空能源方案是实现此愿景的关键卡点。在复杂的太空环境中，具备较高辐射耐受性和极低成本优势的p-HJT电池已被行业广泛认可为下一阶段实现太空光伏大规模应用的最佳技术选择。而p-HJT叠层是通过两端（2-Terminal）叠层结构对底电池的进一步迭代，通过全光谱的高效分段利用，使电池效率对标航天级三结砷化镓30%效率的标准。该叠层技术在实现效率跃迁的同时，能够直接适配现有perc及下一代p-HJT电池的系统设计方案。同时曜能团队通过减薄工艺使叠层电池具备可弯折的特性，在进一步提升比功率（Power-to-Weight）的基础上，能够兼容航天器对于电源系统轻质、柔性的需求。这种兼顾高性能、低量产成本与系统兼容性的特性，使得钙钛矿/p-HJT叠层电池有望应用到低轨卫星系统，乃至宇宙空间站以及未来的太空算力中心，成为太空光伏领域成本与性能最平衡的“终极技术路线”。
曜能科技自成立之初就一直致力于通过叠层技术创新，跨越式降低光伏发电的成本，希望此次针对太空光伏的技术探索能够加速太空能源供给从“高价定制”转向“普惠高效”的转型趋势，结构性降低太空基础设施的能源成本，为人类探索深空及构建地外文明资产提供可靠、高效的绿色能源引擎。

entries.b:
Peter Johnson
| May 28 2026 - 7:24 am PT
new in-house 4nm smart driving chip, China’s first, unlocks “the highest level of vehicle intelligence” with L3 and L4 autonomous driving capabilities.
During its Intelligent Strategy Launch on Thursday, BYD unveiled its latest breakthrough technology, “Xuanji A3,” China’s first self-developed 4nm assisted-driving chip.
CEO Wang Chuanfu said during the event that the new chip supports Level 3 and Level 4 autonomous driving, claiming it “represents the highest level of intelligent driving chips in China.”
Combined with its in-house algorithms used in its God’s Eye ADAS system and Xuanji architecture, BYD said computing power utilization has doubled, up 100%.
Powered by three chips, the combined computing power exceeds a whopping 2,100 TOPS. According to BYD, the new Xuanji A3 smart driving chip has already entered mass production.
The bigger news, however, is that unlike most automakers that outsource chips, BYD builds the chips entirely in-house, along with nearly every other vehicle component.
Chuanfu said that BYD is now the only automaker in the world with full control over its assisted-driving supply chain, enabling it to cut costs and continue advancing the new tech.
Since establishing its first dedicated department for computer chips in 2002, BYD has introduced over 2,000 chips and owns five semiconductor manufacturing (wafer fab) facilities. The company has invested over 100 billion yuan ($14.7 billion) into semiconductors with a current team of over 7,000 dedicated to chip R&D.
The breakthrough assisted-driving chip comes after BYD launched its
Blade Battery 2.0 and Flash Charging system

entries.t: 华为发布半导体与电子系统演进的新原则韬（τ）定律
entries.c: AI与智能科技/AI硬件层/半导体
entries.as: 华为提出韬（τ）定律，以"时间常数缩微"替代"几何缩微"作为半导体演进新原则，通过优化器件寄生参数、逻辑折叠缩短关键路径、全栈软硬芯协同设计和灵衢总线统一内存编址压缩信号时延。过去六年已量产381款芯片，预计2031年晶体管密度达1.4nm同等水平。
entries.cm:
3D堆叠在目前的高带宽内存HBM中用的比较多，就是直接把内存晶圆和计算晶圆做纳米级对齐，然后挤压，直接定点形成化学键，互联在一起。这样大大缩短计算单元和存储单元的空间距离，称作混合键合技术。
逻辑芯片也可以按照这种思路，分层刻蚀，然后层间互联。目前台积电、英特尔、三星这种代工厂在做相关的工艺开发；华为则也会有一些这种芯片的核心设计经验。层间键合也有纳米级精度要求，目前的高精度对准仪可以做到50nm的对准精度，芯片表面会预留用来键合的节点，从而实现集成电路的三维堆叠。这个方式确实可以实现更高的计算单元密度。其主要问题是对准率提高比较困难，以及需要非常精细的化学抛光以实现原子级精度的接触表面，同时会有些散热以及热应变带来的问题。
entries.b:
5月25日，华为在其官网发文，提出了一种半导体产业发展的原则--韬（τ）定律，其能够以“时间（τ，时间常数）缩微”替代“几何缩微”作为半导体与电子系统演进的新指导原则，通过逻辑折叠等创新技术，持续压缩信号传播时延，不断提升晶体管密度，从而实现半导体与电子系统的持续演进。
文中称，其通过优化晶体管和互连电阻及寄生电容，从物理底层最大限度缩微器件级时间常数τ；通过逻辑折叠技术突破传统平面布局的物理边界，缩短关键路径的走线长度并有效降低信号传播的电阻和电容负载，实现晶体管密度和电路性能提升；通过“软件、架构、芯片”的全栈软硬芯协同设计，基于实际工作负载实现指令流和数据流的细粒度控制，提高系统级并行度和效率，降低端到端执行时间；系统层面定义灵衢总线，重构计算系统互联协议，实现超节点的统一内存编址和原生内存语义，降低系统通信时延。
此外文中还宣传，过去六年基于韬（τ）定律，华为已成功设计并量产了381款芯片；预计到2031年，基于韬（τ）定律的高端芯片晶体管密度将达到1.4nm制程的同等水平。

entries.t: ENGINEAI新工厂声称每15分钟生产一台T800人形机器人
entries.c: AI与智能科技/具身智能/硬件和控制
entries.as: 中国机器人公司ENGINEAI在深圳开设了一座占地12.9万平方英尺的智能制造工厂，开始量产人形机器人。首批T800人形机器人已成功下线。该工厂具备极高的生产效率，每台机器人在经过79次检查和46项模拟测试后，能够实现每15分钟下线一台的生产速度。

entries.b:
AI and Robotics
China: ENGINEAI’s 129,000 sq ft factory claims to build one humanoid robot every 15 mins
The new 129,000-square-foot facility can produce one humanoid robot every 15 minutes after 79 inspections and 46 simulation tests.
By
Sujita Sinha
AI and Robotics
May 26, 2026 08:50 AM EST
By
Sujita Sinha
May 26, 2026 08:50 AM EST
ENGINEAI opens Shenzhen robot factory capable of producing one humanoid every 15 minutes.
ENGINEAI/YouTube
A Chinese robotics company, ENGINEAI, has opened a large smart manufacturing facility in Shenzhen to begin mass-producing humanoid robots. The first batch of its T800 humanoid robots has already come off the assembly line at the new plant in the Honghualing district.
This launch comes as China increases its investments in humanoid robotics and automated manufacturing. ENGINEAI said the new facility is designed for high-volume deliveries and quicker commercialization of its robots.
New factory targets fast robot production
The
Shenzhen facility
is about 129,000 square feet and uses a fully integrated manufacturing workflow. The company said the plant handles incoming quality checks, component testing, assembly, pre-shipment testing, logistics, and after-sales service in a single system.
According to ENGINEAI, the setup allows the factory to produce one
humanoid robot
every 15 minutes. The workflow is designed to boost efficiency and keep product quality steady during large-scale production.
Each robot must pass 79 quality checks and 46 simulation tests before shipping. These tests check the robot’s stability, durability, and consistent performance before delivery to customers.
The company believes the new plant will help meet future demand as humanoid robots are used more in industrial and inspection jobs.
Humanoid robots drive company expansion
ENGINEAI was founded in October 2023 and is based in Shenzhen. The company develops both general-purpose intelligent robots and specialized industrial robots.
Its current lineup includes the T800 heavy-duty humanoid robot, the
PM01 humanoid robot
, the lightweight SA02 companion robot, and the JS01 quadruped robot. The company said its products now cover a range of sizes and types, including two-legged humanoids and four-legged robots. The robotics firm has slowly expanded into the industrial and inspection sectors, where companies are seeking robots to handle repetitive, labor-intensive tasks.
Opening the Honghualing manufacturing base is a big step for ENGINEAI as it works to increase production. The company said this project marks its move toward delivering up to 10,000 units.
Zhengzhou facility planned for global manufacturing
The company’s manufacturing expansion is also reaching beyond Shenzhen. The company is planning a global smart manufacturing headquarters in Zhengzhou, Henan province.
A separate production line for 10,000 units is being built at the ENGINEAI Intelligent Manufacturing base in Zhengzhou Yunzhi Science Park. The company said this site will boost manufacturing capacity and help coordinate the regional supply chain.
ENGINEAI added that the Zhengzhou operation will work closely with local suppliers of key parts and support the use of humanoid robots in the region. The company expects the new manufacturing base to improve market services and help future production grow as China’s robotics sector expands.
Funding boost lifts company valuation
ENGINEAI’s expansion comes after a major funding milestone earlier this year. In April, the company
finished
its Series B financing round, raising $200 million.
After the investment, ENGINEAI said its valuation went over 10 billion yuan, or about $1.4 billion. The company called this financing a major milestone that will help grow manufacturing, research, and commercial use of humanoid robots.

entries.t: 清华大学李亚栋报道一种Co/Al氧化物负载Ru单原子催化剂可塑料常压直接热解加氢制航油
entries.as: 清华大学李亚栋院士团队开发Co-Al氧化物负载Ru单原子催化剂（RuSA@CoAlOx），提出加氢热解-气相加氢串联策略，在常压160℃下将废塑料直接转化为航煤环烷烃，选择性超99%，周转频率超商业Ru/C催化剂101倍，50小时连续运行性能稳定，解决传统路线需高压氢气和长反应时间的瓶颈。
entries.b:
将塑料垃圾转化为航空燃料有助于实现航空业脱碳。但直接催化氢解、热解后加氢路线，均存在反应时间长（最长144小时）、需要高压氢气（3 MPa）或工艺复杂等问题，限制了低碳燃料的生产效率和经济性。
近日，清华大学李亚栋院士团队认为加氢步骤增加了工艺的复杂性，并且受到多相传质的限制，阻碍了饱和燃料范围烃的高效生产；由此其提出加氢热解-气相加氢串联策略，将两步整合至同一连续反应器，免去中间冷凝、再加热和再加压过程，实现常压/低压下废塑料直接制航煤环烷烃。团队设计了Co-Al氧化物负载的Ru单原子催化剂（RuSA@CoAlOx），Ru呈+2到+3混合价态单分散，存在Ru-O键而无Ru-Ru相互作用。在160℃和0.15 MPa下，该催化剂实现苯乙烯完全转化，乙基环己烷选择性超99%，周转数达199.6；而Ru纳米颗粒的选择性骤降至20.1%。动力学表明，其表观活化能仅32.8 kJ/mol，远低于商业高负载钌基催化剂，且能迅速消除芳烃积累。连续固定床测试中，其50小时运行保持14.8%转化率和超99%选择性，周转频率达144 s⁻¹，超商业Ru/C和Ru/Al₂O₃催化剂101倍和83倍。理论计算证实，RuSA@CoAlOx费米能级附近的局域钌衍生峰使其芳环加氢能垒显著低于纳米颗粒（0.82 vs 1.06 eV）。工艺产率上，0.15 MPa及常压下环烷烃产率分别达94.8 wt%和59.4 wt%，较传统高压长时工艺在数秒内实现12倍增产，乙基环己烷选择性达94.1%。对聚苯乙烯、聚丙烯与聚乙烯及多种混合废塑料，燃料范围烃产率均达82.3~88 wt%以上。稳定性测试中，使用聚苯乙烯热解油在0.5 MPa下连续运行超110小时，催化剂保持芳烃完全转化，乙基环己烷选择性稳定在90%以上。
此外，研究对制备的航煤环烷烃进行了燃烧性能与环保经济性评估。燃烧性能方面，740 K下喷油1.9 ms即初始发光，温度升至820 K和900 K时发光时间分别提前至1.3 ms和0.8 ms；且仅需40 MPa低压即可有效点火，远低于传统柴油所需的100 MPa以上。环保性上，生产1 MJ航煤产生4.3 g CO₂当量，较石油基航煤（15.7 g）减少73%。经济性方面，圣保罗最低售价为1.0美元/kg，伦敦和东京因能源及氢气成本较高为1.6–1.8美元/kg，催化剂、氢气和废塑料采购成本的波动是对最低售价影响最大的因素。文章于2026年5月27日发表在Nature Energy。

entries.t: 首尔大学Jungwon Park通过原子数可控的铂团簇实现强锚定高催化活性并提高制氢性能
entries.as: 首尔大学Jungwon Park团队通过甲醇还原法在氧化铝表面制备强锚定铂簇催化剂，实现对簇中原子数的精确调控（负载量不同原子数差异可达三倍）。铂原子选择性迁移至氧化铝五配位Al³⁺强相互作用位点，1nm尺度兼具高活性和高稳定性，可放大至20克级合成，为氢能载体脱氢反应提供了贵金属高效利用方案。
entries.cm:
在传统负载型金属催化剂中，纳米颗粒虽稳定性较好，但大量内部原子无法参与表面反应，导致贵金属利用率低；而单原子催化剂虽活性高，却易在反应条件下团聚失活。本文通过团簇与Al₂O₃载体形成更强相互作用以降低失活速率，同时通过原子数的精确调控来平衡耐久性和活性
显著提升贵金属利用效率.没有显著降低反应温度，主要在300°C进行，没有显著提高体积、质量储氢密度
entries.b:
在传统负载型金属催化剂中，纳米颗粒虽稳定性较好，但大量内部原子无法参与表面反应，导致贵金属利用率低；而单原子催化剂虽活性高，却易在反应条件下团聚失活。如何在1nm尺度实现既高活性又高稳定性的催化剂，一直是催化领域的重要挑战。
首尔大学Jungwon Park等人通过创新方法制备出强锚定于氧化铝载体的铂簇，实现了对簇中原子数的精确调控，揭示了原子数对簇-载体相互作用、催化活性和稳定性的关键影响，为氢能载体脱氢反应提供了解决方案。
研究团队采用甲醇还原PtCl₄²⁻前驱体，在氧化铝表面原位生成无配体铂原子，并通过空气煅烧和氢气还原，使铂原子选择性迁移至氧化铝边缘强相互作用位点（主要是(100)面Al³⁺五配位位点），形成均匀的铂簇催化剂。该方法可放大至20克级一锅合成，有效避免了传统方法中配体残留导致的颗粒尺寸不均问题。
通过球差校正扫描透射电子显微镜和原子级表征，团队发现这些看似直径均为1纳米的铂簇，实际原子数差异显著。在0.1 wt%、0.25 wt%和0.5 wt% Pt负载量下，最常见原子数分别为约13、25和31，差异可达三倍。尽管平面尺寸相似，但原子数少的簇更接近双层结构，原子数多的则趋向三层结构。这种结构差异直接影响簇与载体的相互作用强度：X射线吸收谱（XAFS）显示，原子数越多，Pt-Al五配位相互作用越强，电子态更接近金属态，但仍保持无定形非晶结构。
在甲基环己烷（MCH）脱氢制氢反应中，这些铂簇展现出优异性能。相比传统纳米颗粒催化剂，簇催化剂氢气产率显著提升，其中0.1 wt% Pt样品初始比活性最高，得益于更高的表面原子暴露比例和结构柔性；0.5 wt% Pt样品则表现出最佳耐久性和选择性（>99.9%），因强载体相互作用抑制了甲苯强吸附导致的积碳。原位DRIFTS和Raman光谱证实，簇催化剂上形成的积碳更软、更无序，不会快速堵塞活性位点。
DFT计算进一步验证了实验发现：MCH在Pt₁₃簇上的结合能更强，有利于活化，而Pt₃₁簇对甲苯的吸附较弱，有利于产物脱附和抗积碳。该催化剂在300°C下氢气产率达3000–12000 mmol H₂/gPt/min，远超此前报道的最高值；在340°C、较高空速下仍能维持高转化率，展现出显著的贵金属利用效率优势。
研究强调，簇催化剂的性能不仅取决于尺寸，更关键在于原子数的精细调控及由此带来的簇-载体界面相互作用。这一发现为设计新一代亚纳米催化剂提供了重要指导，有望推动氢能存储与运输领域的实际应用。文章于2026年5月28日发表在Science。
